spatial_autocorrelation_adjustment.spatial_interpretation: Accounts for geographic clustering in the Bengawan Solo and Brantas drainage basins. The association remains statistically significant (p_spatial = 0.0074 < 0.01) after correcting for spatial degrees of freedom.

sampling_design_and_selection_bias.cohort_type: Purposive / targeted benchmark reporting cohort (n = 9 regencies)
sampling_design_and_selection_bias.selection_criteria: Official gazetted drought emergency status (Status Tanggap Darurat Bencana Kekeringan) during 2023 compound El Niño, plus 1 southern montane forested buffer control (Pacitan)
sampling_design_and_selection_bias.limitations: Non-random sample of reporting jurisdictions. Non-reporting municipalities (e.g. humid montane enclaves like Kota Batu or urban non-agricultural centers like Surabaya) are excluded. Findings reflect crisis reporting patterns across vulnerable agricultural landscapes rather than a province-wide probability sample.

empirical_ground_truth_validation.disaster_concentration: Benchmark cohort captures 279 drought emergency villages (~50% of provincial total of ~566 villages). The 8 acute emergency regencies (LSI >= 0.55) encompass 273 villages (97.8% of cohort), with the 3 critical regencies (LSI >= 0.65) accounting for 125 villages (44.8%). Pacitan (LSI = 0.320) serves as montane forest buffer control (6 villages, 2.2%).
empirical_ground_truth_validation.methodological_rationale: To maintain empirical integrity and avoid unverified agricultural damage claims, ground-truth validation is benchmarked against officially gazetted disaster filings from BPBD Provinsi Jawa Timur during the severe 2023 compound El Niño. Village water-crisis filings measure municipal-level drought emergencies independently of agricultural planting decisions (adaptive fallow / bero), though local reporting administrative capacity, population density, and baseline infrastructure remain unmodeled covariates. The strong statistical concordance (r = 0.9328, rho = 0.9500, p_spatial = 0.0074) supports the utility of satellite-derived Landscape Sensitivity (LSI) for identifying regional drought hotspots.

temporal_progression.wave_2_hydrological: May–July 2024 - Delayed monsoon onset (Pacitan MT-1 desiccation in Jan, 5,747 ha) culminating in catastrophic canal desiccation in May 2024 (22,668 ha in a single month)

data_rectification_forensics.root_cause_1: ETL naming corruption: 7 twin regencies (Blitar, Kediri, Malang, Probolinggo, Pasuruan, Mojokerto, Madiun) erroneously entered under KOTA prefixes for 71 months
data_rectification_forensics.root_cause_2: Provincial total aggregate rows keyed with district code 0 present across 33 months, inducing 200% double-counting in unrectified sums
data_rectification_forensics.zero_value_distribution: 97.16% true zero reporting due to seasonal wet cycles, highly urban non-agricultural centers, and minimal soybean cultivation
